fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of total net sales (net sales = gross sales less sales tax and use tax); late fee of 1.5%/month interest plus $25/week on overdue amounts. National Advertising Fund currently 3% of total net sales with right to increase to 4%. Local Advertising is an additional 1% of total net sales spent independently on franchisor-approved advertising. Brand Technology System Support Services: $840–$1,500/year for mandatory services plus up to $3,250/year for optional services (paid quarterly); no single monthly tech fee disclosed. Transfer fee $15,000; Renewal fee 40% of then-current initial fees. Unapproved Product/Supplier Fee $500/day.
